claims.claim_vi: Scan-to-pay splits into two sub-processes: the merchant generates and displays a QR code, then the consumer scans it and pays.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Generating the code (7 steps): the cashier totals the goods (for example $123.45, with an order ID), clicks checkout; the cashier's computer sends the order ID and amount to the PSP; the PSP saves it and generates a QR code URL; the PSP's payment gateway reads it and returns it to the merchant's computer, which sends it to the checkout counter, which displays the QR code; these 7 steps complete in less than a second.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Paying (5 steps): the consumer opens the digital wallet app to scan, confirms the amount and clicks pay; the wallet app notifies the PSP that the code was paid; the PSP payment gateway marks the code as paid and returns success to the wallet app; the gateway notifies the merchant.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: This is the merchant-presented dynamic mode of the QR lesson (the code carries an order amount); that mapping is the author's reading of the two sources.
claims.verified_by: Author's reasoning from the two source bodies.

design_notes_vi: Hai lược đồ nối nhau cho hai quy trình của nguồn. Lược đồ một có hai bên và một bước tự quầy (hiển thị mã); lược đồ hai có ba bên, vì người bán được báo ở cuối.
source_deviations: The source lists 7 + 5 steps; the lesson groups them into two sequences and leaves the cashier-side steps (total the order, click checkout, hand the address to the counter) in the text.
The source gives an order ID and an amount of $123.45; the lesson keeps the amount and does not print an order number.
The lesson ties the process to the four QR modes of the related lesson as marked reasoning.
